column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Computation Worksheet for line 12, for taxable income of $100,000 or more: (a) line 11 times (b) the multiplication amount, less (d) the subtraction amount. Each row holds base_tax = -(d) and of_excess_over = 0.
# note: Rows read "at least X but less than Y" and "Y or over"; incomes are whole dollars, so the first row ends one dollar below Y and the second starts over that dollar.
# note: Section A covers single and head of household and is repeated for both. Wisconsin has no qualifying surviving spouse status.
# note: The instructions round amounts to the nearest dollar, up from 50 cents (page 13).
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
